mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the retinas to the focusing parts brought the whole light path together, making the separate pieces easier to understand.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas, lenses and irises one at a time felt a little repetitive, even though their different jobs were clear.

surprise.text: The lens comparison showed that flatter and rounder shapes bend light by different amounts.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and named slots gave each fitting a purpose. Some later steps were the only offered combination rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes. Putting the light path together was satisfying, and I'd be curious to see another body system connected in the same way.
